verdict.stance: Overweight / Top-Tier CEMBI IG Bank Anchor
verdict.summary: Israel's largest bank delivered record 9M26 earnings (NIS 8.2bn, +5.9% YoY; Q3 NIS 3.0bn) with sector-best 26% cost-to-income and ultra-clean 0.43% NPLs. June 2026 $1bn 5.70% Tier 2 CoCo issue (+155bp) underscores tight market access; sovereign/geopolitical risk caps IG rating (A-/Baa1/BBB+).

positives: Exceptional asset quality: 0.43% NPL ratio (troubled debt down to 1.06% vs 1.24% FY25) and Q3 CoR of just 13bp.
Elite operating efficiency: Q326 CIR improved to 26% with 16.9% ROE (18.5% ex-special bank tax levy).
Deep domestic funding & liquidity: 120% LCR and $2.6bn well-laddered USD senior/Tier 2 curve.
negatives: Sovereign linkage & geopolitical risk: Ratings (A-/Baa1/BBB+) constrained by Israel sovereign trajectory and conflict risk.
Special bank tax levy & 50% payout ratio (NIS 1.5bn Q3 div/buyback) limit CET1 accumulation (11.38% vs 12.7%+ European peers).
Rapid 12.7% YTD loan growth (NIS 586.1bn, led by +20.5% corporate/infra) requires monitoring if domestic growth slows.

background.business_overview: Israel's largest commercial bank by assets (NIS 873bn FY25) with leading corporate, mortgage, retail, and tech-banking franchises.
background.asset_perimeter: Domestic Israeli commercial/retail banking plus Leumi UK and international corporate desks.
background.ownership_governance: Widely held on Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE: LUMI); supervised by Bank of Israel.
